title: cc-firewall policy
description: User-level policy for the cc-firewall PreToolUse hook (~/.claude/cc-firewall.json).

$schema.description: URL or path of this schema, for editor completion. Ignored by cc-firewall.

mode.description: enforce returns deny/ask to Claude Code; audit only logs would-deny / would-ask.

log_allowed.description: Also log calls that no rule matched.

rules.description: Every rule is checked; deny beats ask, and no match means allow.

tests.description: Test cases run by `cc-firewall test`. The hook never reads them.

id.description: Unique, stable name shown in the reason and the audit log.

tools.description: Tool names or fnmatch patterns such as mcp__*. Case-sensitive.

field.description: The tool_input key to test, or * for every string value and object key in the input.

glob.description: fnmatch pattern matched against the whole value, treated as a path.

regex.description: Python regular expression searched anywhere in the value.

unless_glob.description: Exception: a value matching this glob does not trigger the rule.

unless_regex.description: Exception: a value matching this regex does not trigger the rule.

cwd_glob.description: The rule applies only when the session's working directory matches this glob; a trailing /** also matches the directory itself. A convenience for scoping rules, not a security boundary: the working directory follows the session, so a cd elsewhere moves it out of scope.

reason.description: Text shown to Claude (deny) or to you in the prompt (ask).

tool.description: Tool name of the simulated call.

cwd.description: Working directory of the simulated call, for rules with cwd_glob.

expect.description: The decision the policy must give.
